pyramiding_rule: Zero pyramiding into active high-frequency pullbacks; strictly prohibit secondary order stacking within 50 pips of an existing losing position.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory order-flow imbalance filter and ATR volatility expansion check before execution; block entries when spread exceeds 35% of the average 5-candle range.
profit_harvest_threshold: Dynamic trailing stop activation at +$4.00 unrealized profit, forcing the engine to scale out portions and allow winners to stretch toward the $15.00-$30.00 objective.
